mentions.name: Marathon training workout Discord agent
mentions.description: Agent built with the Capsule Agents framework and running live in the author's homelab; it sends a Discord message every morning with the workout scheduled for the author's marathon training and the rationale behind it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm training for a marathon and its able to send a discord message every morning with the workout on my schedule and the "why" behind it.
